//: Capability manifest for <SidebarSearch> (the .pc-sidebar__search entry point) — svelte-pure-admin. SidebarSearch.svelte renders <li class="pc-sidebar__item"> wrapping EITHER a trigger <button class="pc-sidebar__search"> (default) OR, when `action` is set, a type-and-go <form class="pc-sidebar__search pc-sidebar__search--input"> (submit magnifier .pc-sidebar__search-icon + .pc-sidebar__search-field input). Shared SSR features: the trigger label, the action string (→ form mode), the root class passthrough.
